absent: Inflate and deflate page acquisition, host notification, and acknowledgement handling beyond call sites
Statistics collection content, buffer layout, and count semantics
Wakeup event start, process, and finish semantics and signal values
Virtqueue lookup, offer, reclaim, kick, size query, reset, and deletion semantics
Feature negotiation, device ready, and configuration change transport mechanics
Balloon configuration structure full layout beyond named members
Page reporting registration and free page report callback behavior
Shrinker allocation and registration plus out of memory notifier mechanics
Workqueue allocation, freezing, cancellation, and destruction semantics

findings.text: Probe validates configuration access, allocates device state, initializes size and statistics workers with stop synchronization and acknowledgement wait, builds queues, then conditionally establishes free page hint workqueue and list with shrinker, out of memory notification, poison value, and page reporting before enabling wakeup capability, marking ready, and triggering an initial adjustment when off target.

Configuration change handling and statistics queue callback both defer work unless updates are stopped. The size path schedules adjustment plus hint work, while the statistics path schedules statistics work, each paired with a distinct wakeup signal.

Quiesce unregisters reporting, memory pressure, and shrinker services, blocks further updates, and cancels outstanding workers including hint reporting when present. Remove additionally destroys the hint workqueue, drains balloon and hint holdings, resets the device, and deletes queues. Freeze drains holdings, while restore rebuilds queues, marks ready, reevaluates target, and republishes size.

Size adjustment computes signed distance to aligned host target, grows the balloon when positive and shrinks it when negative, publishes the resulting actual count, then requeues the same work while residual remains and otherwise completes the wakeup event.

Statistics handling primes the queue with one buffer at initialization, then on host signal consumes the prior completion, refreshes collected values, offers a fresh output buffer sized to the refreshed count, and notifies the host. The worker wraps this handling with wakeup begin and end.

Free page hint reporting caches the host command identifier on demand, emits a start marker after draining completions, repeatedly allocates large blocks and offers them while the active identifier is unchanged, then emits a stop marker. A completion marker releases all held blocks, while stop or duplicate identifiers suppress reporting.

The stop flag is guarded by a stop lock used in both plain and interrupt saving forms across request, change, and quiesce paths. The hint list and block counter are guarded by a hint list lock held across traversal, insertion, removal, and counter update. Page migration uses nonblocking acquisition of the balloon mutex and defers when contended to avoid deadlock with inflation and compaction.

Host desired page count is read as little endian regardless of native order and rounded up to guest page granularity before comparison with local holdings. Local holdings are written back as little endian actual, and poison and hint command identifier fields follow the same little endian configuration convention.

Inflate and deflate queues are always established, while statistics, free page, and reporting queues are established only when the matching feature is negotiated. The driver advertises must tell host, statistics, deflate on memory pressure, free page hint, page poison, and reporting. Free page reporting requires a ring of at least two entries because one entry stays reserved for command identifiers.

Validation conditions poison and reporting features on memory initialization support and disables indirect descriptors and platform access. Reporting defaults to unspecified order with a narrower order on one large page configuration and capacity derived from ring size.

Memory pressure reclamation rounds requested pages up to hint block size and accounts holdings as block count times block pages. The memory pressure callback deflates a fixed amount, normalizes by guest page factor into freed count, republishes size, and reports success.

Page migration under one mutex hold first inflates the replacement page then deflates the source page, each using a per guest page frame count, avoiding contention with concurrent inflation or deflation by retrying later.

Statistics buffer offer failure triggers a one time warning and aborts without host notification. Free page allocation exhaustion cleanly ends the scan, other send errors are logged but still attempt a stop marker, and probe failures unwind workqueue, shrinker, notifier, reporting, and queue resources in reverse order.

The balloon instance aggregates device linkage, inflate deflate statistics free page and reporting queue handles, statistics storage, size and statistics workers plus a dedicated hint workqueue and hint work, stop and wakeup synchronization with acknowledgement wait, balloon mutex, hint list with block count, command identifier cache with active and stop values, shrinker and notifier linkage, page reporting info, and frame accounting.

The driver object publishes feature and identifier tables under the module name and binds probe, remove, shutdown, configuration change, validation, and suspend resume callbacks for lifecycle management by the virtio core.
